plan_review.notes: plan_review flagged 4 blocking concerns: (1) terrain-rebake staleness on late boss-defeat, (2) unreliable event-length dirty flag, (3) FamilyMembership.familyId is a Uint8 index into presentFamilies (not a FamilyId string), (4) irregular cave rooms carry interiorCells so bounds-based tile stamping over-tints walls. Slice 7 addresses these by (a) scoping the minimap tint to room-level dot color (no per-tile terrain baking, so 1 + 4 collapse), (b) using a snapshot-fingerprint dirty flag on the widget that reads relation+band+bossDefeated per family instead of factionRelationEvents.length, and (c) resolving family index -> FamilyId via resolveFamilyByIndex in minimap-family-tint.ts. 3 non-blocking suggestions on naming + panel geometry were adopted.
